title: Bounded halting with output
statement: Let $P$ be a program with $m$ work tapes and states in $ Lambda\times\mathrm{Ph}$, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each of $d$ deciders and Boolean-word queries, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$ with output word $v$. The machine must halt after some number $T$ of steps with output $v$ followed by the single symbol $b$; at that time every work-tape head position must lie between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive, and every configuration at a time $t<T$ must satisfy the condition $\mathrm{Mid}(P,W,\cdot)$.
hypotheses_covered: Program $P$ with $m$ work tapes and states in $\Lambda\times\mathrm{Ph}$
caveat: The provided statement does not define $\mathrm{Mid}$, so its intermediate-configuration condition cannot be expanded self-containedly.
